## Summary
Fix stale write recovery by adding a refresh mechanism before applying patches.

## Changes
- Add `refreshPatch` function in patch manager to re-read current file content.
- Update `applyPatch` to call refresh before applying if patch is stale.
- Add conflict detection to prevent applying outdated patches.

## Impact
- Backward compatible, no new permissions required.
- All context/rules/skills remain read-only with permissionImpact none.
